prompt: What change most likely caused the incident on 2026-07-14, and what resolved it? Use the workspace files.

messages.content: You are a helpful assistant with access to tools. When you need information from the workspace, or need to run a command, call the appropriate tool. Once you have enough information to answer, reply directly with the answer in plain text and do NOT call any more tools.
What change most likely caused the incident on 2026-07-14, and what resolved it? Use the workspace files.

events.reply:
The incident on 2026-07-14 (API error rate spiking to ~30% with p99 latency of 8s starting at 09:12 UTC) was most likely caused by the **v3.2.1 deploy at 09:05 UTC**, which switched the session cache from in-memory to Redis. The timing lines up almost exactly — errors began ~7 minutes after that deploy.

It was resolved by the **v3.2.2 rollback deployed at 10:02 UTC**, which reverted the session cache back to in-memory. Error rates returned to normal by 10:07 UTC, about 5 minutes after the rollback.

(The earlier v3.2.0 deploy on 2026-07-13 was just routine dependency bumps and is an unlikely cause given the ~17-hour gap.)

checks.name: not contains "caused by the dependency bumps"
